name: Stooges Leather Jacket
note: First-release season is single-sourced. Lapels are a fold collar over a V neck with painted lapel seams; epaulettes are stitched lines.

name: Intarsia Leather Jacket
note: No single debut season is documented for this carry-over style; SS2017 is a documented example. Collar zip drawn in the collar frame.

name: DRKSHDW Waxed Detroit Jeans
note: A permanent fit with no documented first season; FW2017 is a documented waxed run. The extra length that stacks at the ankle is painted as creases, not cut.

name: Slab Denim and Leather Jacket
note: The Slab line as its representative jacket: oil-washed black denim body with washed leather sleeves. Price and season are estimates (dated pieces are FW2004 or FW2005). No photograph of a Slab jacket loaded; built from the research description. Denim and leather share one sheen.

name: Exploder Leather Jacket
note: Price is an estimate (low confidence). No photograph of the black FW07 hi-collar jacket loaded; shaped from the FW07 alpaca Exploder, a black Rick Owens high-collar asymmetric-zip jacket and the research description. The collar is shown zipped up; it cannot fall open into the draped lapel.

name: Babel Rod Parka
note: The rods are fixed in: the body is pushed out to one side and its hem slants, with the rod channels as ridges.

name: Scarstitch Leather Jacket
note: A recurring construction with no single documented season. The raised scar seams are painted as ridges; they do not stand off the surface.

name: Overlock Leather Jacket
note: Cut and zip line follow an SS07 overlock fencing jacket (photographed in white cloth); made here in black object-dyed leather as the research describes. Overlocked seams are painted bands, not raised thread.

name: Distressed Leather Biker Jacket
note: Price is an estimate (low confidence). The FW06 ram rider's own photographs did not load; built from the research description with a later Julius rider for the leather's surface.

name: Layered Object-Dyed Leather Jacket
note: A family of J-series jackets rather than one piece; FW2012 is a documented example and the price an estimate. No photograph loaded: built from the research description.

name: Bondage Fishtail Parka
note: The inner shoulder straps the parka hangs from are worn on the outside of the back, where they can be seen.

name: Painter Jeans
note: Each real pair is painted by hand; this is one scatter of white and silver.

name: Classic Denim Jacket
note: A 1996-2004 staple rather than a one-season piece; FW1996 is when the jeans line began.

name: M69 Flak Jacket
note: Price is an estimate (no sold comparables). Detachable sleeves and removable liner are not modelled; side lacing is painted.
